name: imodwt
expr: w = modwt(x, 'haar', 3); xrec = imodwt(w, 'haar'); err = max(abs(xrec(:) - x(:))); ycx = imodwt(complex(w, 0.5), 'haar'); ysgl = imodwt(single(w), 'haar');
comment: Sig: x = imodwt(w, wname). Inverse MODWT. Round-trip imodwt(modwt(x)) recovers x to machine precision — the structurally important invariant. The internal coefficient values diverge from MATLAB R2025b (kernel filter-convention gap, see modwt.json comment); both engines independently recover x correctly from THEIR OWN coefficients. Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: w in {double, single} + complex (the integer classes and logical reject - probed InvalidCFSSize); complex w reconstructs complex with the imaginary offset riding the kernel unchanged (imodwt(ones)=1, probed both engines); both H and N must be >= 2. Round-trip invariant from the original spec kept.
